observations: Orange drilling rig mounted on a white truck chassis.
The truck has a 'Nissan Diesel' badge on the front grille.
The rig features a long mast and a drilling head assembly.
The vehicle is parked on a dirt lot with other construction equipment visible in the background.
The truck's front bumper is heavily soiled and shows signs of rust.
The rig appears to be a used, heavy-duty piece of equipment.

claims.evidence: The rig is shown in a static, dusty environment; mechanical operation cannot be confirmed from still photos.
There is no video or photo of the rig in operation.
The photos show the item in a storage yard, but the specific location is not confirmed.

risks.risk: The engine may be non-functional or have significant wear.
risks.proof: A video of the truck starting and running, or a photo of the engine compartment with the hood open.

risks.risk: The hydraulic system may be leaking or unable to support the rig's weight.
risks.proof: A video showing the rig being raised and lowered by hydraulic power.

risks.risk: The drilling head or mast may be damaged or unable to rotate.
risks.proof: A video showing the mast rotating and the drill bit moving.
risks.if_unproven: as requiring a complete replacement of the head and mast

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Video of the truck starting and the rig being operated.
Video of the hydraulic system raising and lowering the mast.
Photo of the engine compartment and the oil condition.
response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
